status: Design registered only; execution deferred until official photometry baseline and duplicate sensitivity gate.
observation_level: Calibrated signed FLUXCAL at individual epochs; preserve uncertainties, calibrations and passbands; no corrected-distance residual target.
models: Released SALT3 empirical colour law with original template/model covariance
Same intrinsic template with explicit F99 host extinction law plus a separately parameterized intrinsic colour component, with finite preregistered priors
Each with optional host/luminosity/population terms constrained on training folds only
identifiability: Intrinsic colour and dust are not separately identified by a flexible unbounded colour decomposition. Priors and external constraints must be frozen and sensitivity-tested; SALT3 is itself trained on calibrated observations. F99 changes are scientific alternatives, not raw measurements.
holdout_unit: Hold out all rows from a single exposure together. Use deterministic CID-hash folds stratified by available bands, redshift and field. Parent will freeze seed and fold count before execution. Separate leave-one-band-out predictions from held-out-epoch predictions; no duplicate exposure can cross folds.
leakage_controls: Fit t0,x0,x1,colour/dust only to training bands/epochs. Recompute initialization if it uses held-out flux. Published cosmology-sample membership conditions the experiment and must be stated; no classification/selection probability may be estimated from held-out outcomes.
comparisons: Held-out signed-flux log predictive density with measurement and model covariance
residual versus rest wavelength, phase, redshift, host properties and signal-to-noise
same objects and same held-out measurements across alternatives
interpretation: Better prediction of observed bands tests colour/correction adequacy conditionally, not acceleration or an identified progenitor age law. Training/calibration/selection uncertainty and missing full host PDFs remain explicit. Do not optimize dust priors on the holdout test set.
